pay_detail: Listed tuition $5,430, or $5,230 if you pay by Jan 31. Housing $4,200. $50 registration fee. Scholarships exist (see the Scholarships page).
duration: 5 weeks (listed dates July 9 to August 13; year not shown on the page)
name: Aspire: Five-Week Music Performance Intensive
org: Berklee College of Music Summer Programs
what_you_do: Five weeks of jam sessions, bands and one on one lessons with Berklee teachers on the Boston campus. Students come from many countries.
who_can_apply: Students age 15 and older with at least six months of playing or singing experience.
deadline_text: The page says to register by June 1 and pay by Jan 31 for a discount, but shows no year. An audition date on the page is July 6, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not confirmed.
how_to_apply: Register online, then pay tuition in full to hold your spot. Request housing in your account if you need it, and finish the checklist there.
notes: Costs money. The year of the listed dates is not shown, so confirm dates, prices and any audition steps on the page.
